sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for sharing the cost background and for your continued support; we value our relationship with your family-owned business. Our committed volume is our full demand for this part over the term, and we can offer a long contract term to support your planning, with our forecast rising. We understand your management has frozen price cuts, so while we cannot offer a larger-volume commitment, could you walk us through your calculation, as your owner once offered?

We confirm a binding volume of 20000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).
In our call of 2026-06-16 (doc:20260616-70620-M6) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We are willing to accept the 36-month contract duration to support your long-term planning.
Regarding your request for a calculation walkthrough, please understand that we cannot share our detailed internal cost breakdown beyond the indices already provided.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €4.88 per unit.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our proposal and for moving your offer; we appreciate the effort, and understand that your management has frozen price reductions and that you can’t share a more detailed cost breakdown. We value our long relationship and recognise that larger-volume customers are a focus for you; our fixed full demand for this part, rising forecast and long contract term offer volume and planning security. Our proposal moves toward you again, and we hope it gives us a basis to continue the agreement together.

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
We appreciate your revised proposal and your commitment to our business relationship.
However, we are unable to accommodate further price reductions.
Therefore, €4.94 per unit for a 36-month contract with 90 days payment terms is our final offer.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
